text.id: Sore. HP-nya udah tujuh puluh persen. Dinda ketiduran di sofa, akhirnya, dengan buku kuliah kebuka di dadanya.
text.en: Late afternoon. The phone is at seventy percent. Dinda has finally fallen asleep on the sofa, a textbook open on her chest.

text.id: Gue belum buka grup, belum buka chat Bima atau Tasya. Ada satu hal yang harus gue lihat duluan, sebelum gue bisa mikir jernih soal yang lain.
text.en: I haven't opened the group, or Bima's chat, or Tasya's. There's one thing I have to see first, before I can think straight about anything else.
The chat with my name on it.

text.id: Isinya bukan cuma satu pesan gagal kirim. Di atasnya, ada puluhan pesan yang nggak pernah dikirim sama sekali. Masih draf. Tanggalnya macem-macem, sepanjang setahun.
text.en: It's not just one failed message. Above it are dozens of messages that were never sent at all. Still drafts. All different dates, spread across the year.

text.id: Maret. "gue denger lo di bandung. dingin ga"
text.en: March. "heard you're in bandung. is it cold"

text.id: Juni. "ep 9 tayang. editornya baru. dia ga sebawel lo soal noise. gue kangen dibawelin"
text.en: June. "ep 9 is out. new editor. he doesn't nag about noise like you did. i miss being nagged"
The August one doesn't go any further.

text.id: Kenapa nggak lo kirim, Kar.{w} ...Kenapa gue nggak pernah nanya.
text.en: Why didn't you send it, Kar.{w} ...Why didn't I ever ask.

text.id: Paling bawah, sebelum pesan yang gagal itu, ada satu voice note yang juga belum kekirim. Durasinya dua puluhan detik.
text.en: At the very bottom, before the failed message, there's a voice note that was never sent either. About twenty seconds long.

text.id: Ka. Aneh juga, ya, ngomong sendiri gini. Ini juga nggak bakal kekirim. Tapi gue perlu cerita. Ke orang selain Tasya sama Bima.
text.en: Ka. This is stupid, talking to a phone that won't send anything. But I need to talk to someone who isn't Tasya, isn't Bima.

text.id: Gue nemu sesuatu. Sesuatu yang gede. Dan gue rasa ada yang ngebocorin kalau gue punya itu.{w} Kalau gue ngilang, lo tahu harus mulai dari mana.
text.en: I found something. Something big. And I think someone leaked that I have it.{w} If I disappear, you'll know where to start.

text.id: Gue kunci layarnya. Dua puluh detik. Gue udah setahun nggak denger suaranya langsung ke gue. Dua puluh detik lagi bisa nunggu sampai gue siap.
text.en: I lock the screen. Twenty seconds. I haven't heard her voice talking to me in a year. Twenty more seconds can wait until I'm ready.
